text: Try to make it out of the restraints and take control of the situation ⇒
You struggle, attempting to break out of the CABLES that tie you to the CHAIR. With all of your might, you pull, however it isn't enough. You gasp loudly as you feel the CABLE cutting into YOUR ARMS.
F-Fuck!
Your mouth continues to foam with blood and saliva as you curse out. You stop trying to pull yourself out of your binds. FELPS trembles on the FLOOR and stands.
You... you murdered him!
Bullshit.
Your lover boy killed himself. Karmic retribution.
FELPS scowls at WES and picks up the MAGGO-PISTOL, inspecting it. He sighs loudly.
You know, I could easily kill you both right now.
Do it. Pull the trigger.
You glare into FELPS'S EYES and smirk. WES is taken aback by your aggressiveness.
Emmett, what the fuck? I don't want to die!
FELPS'S HAND trembles as he tries to evaluate what to do next. You try to get back up, but the CHAIR isn't budging.
I dare you.
FELPS frowns and drops the GUN.
No. I can only tolerate so much bloodshed in one day. Even if he was a brilliant mind.
WES sighs and mumbles.
That's a relief.
Coward.
FELPS grimaces.
You're in no position to speak to me that way, asshole.
You fall limp in your CHAIR, your CHEEK and EAR on the ground. The adrenaline's gone, but the throbbing persists.
What are you going to do with us?
FELPS sighs.
Well, I could easily turn you guys in.
God, I don't want to be in a brig again.
You grumble. Prison. What a way to end your days.
We got you your blackmail stuff. The stick.
Did you, or did you just team up with him to try and take this?

FELPS takes out a desk lamp shaped RELIC encased in brass. Where a lamp would be is instead replaced with a claw that has a lens in its center. Its base is a ring with various inscriptions and symbols on it, most indecipherable to you.
The Orbacle.
So that's what we nearly died over?
Tell me, did you expect me to just give this to you guys?

FELPS puts a HAND on the neck of the RELIC, turning a gear-shaped band. A bright light appears, produced from the BRASS CLAW above. As FELPS turns the dial, the projection becomes brighter and more clear. From your position, you can't make out what's inside it, though you believe there's a CROWN within it.
No. I don't care what you do with it.
Then why did you break into my base of operations?
I want answers, and I thought Felic had a change of heart.
WES scoffs.
Quite naive, aren't we? You should know by now know never to trust anyone.
I just want to be left alone now.
Yeah, well, should've thought about that before getting Felic killed.
What, and just let him kill me?
Duh. His life was way more valuable than yours.
You're an asshole.
Aren't we all?
You roll your eyes.
Take these binds off already.
Hmm...
FELPS stares at THE ORBACLE for a second before glancing at you.
You want answers, huh?
I want to know where Squorchy is.
Oh, but didn't Felic tell you? The Orbacle corrupts. It gives and gives and gives you everything you want...
FELPS wags his FINGERS, dancing them as he speaks.
And then it takes and takes and takes!
You scoff, cringing at FELPS's performance.
Maybe it's because what you want is something stupid, like "supreme knowledge of the universe" or "tyrant of the Galactic Union". You know, things you would need to kill and ruin lives for.
FELPs hisses at you.
What? You wouldn't want a taste of true freedom?
You grimace.
You know, I think true freedom is me getting out of these shackles and gouging your eyes out.
A pity you're still tied up then, isn't it?
Emmett, curb your bloodlust and appease the man.
You frown.
What do you want for a peek at The Orbacle?
Oh, no no no! I'm not going to let you seek The Orbacle. I'll peruse it for you.
You groan.
Ah yes, the person who has threatened to imprison me is going to be truthful in what the artifact tells him.
What do you have to lose? I did promise I would give you this...
FELPS flashes the ENCRYPTED DISC and tosses it at you. You look at the side of the DISC that FELPS was hiding from you.
Hilarious.
You furrow YOUR BROW as you see written on the DISC, "I.O.U.".
I swear to Squoat...
I kid, I kid.
FELPS chuckles to himself.
I'll release you on one condition.
WES interjects before you can respond.
What do we need to do?
Remember those jobs I was talking about? You're going to do them.
What are the jobs?
Not important. I just need your word. If you help me, I might help you.
FELIC holds THE ORBACLE and within shows an ORANGE SQUOATLING chopping what appears to be a TREE.
Well, do you accept?
Call Felps's bluff and threaten him. ⇒
You bare YOUR TEETH at FELPS, knowing that he's not going to help you.
Don't you dare show me your perverse depictions of her.
Damn it, Emmett, just fucking say you'll do what he says.
You growl, a familiar bestial feeling emerging from your depths. FELPS picks up a COMMUNICATOR, sneering at your attempt to intimidate.
I'm taking that as a "no", then, correct? You want to be executed by the Union?
You're not going to help me. You're just evil.
FELPS laughs mockingly.

No, I just want to known for something greater than what I am. You, on the other hand, are making yourself known to be an imbecile for not taking this deal. You have no leverage. You either obey or you waste away.
I'm not allying with fucking scum.
Funny, to me it looks like you've already been tossed away. All the blood and crumbs and all.
You breathe heavily, spitting out some more BLOOD. You feel a mix of The Crave, a longing to fall asleep, and a sinister need to brutalize THIS MAN. Your hormones are all over the place.
The moment you let me go...
YOUR HEAD droops a bit, the blood loss starting to get to you.
I will take these chains...
You flick a terrifying gaze at FELPS.
And I will watch as the life escapes your eyes. You'll amount to nothing, as you already do.
Nothing? You threatening my life is really making me want to protect myself, you know.
FELPS picks up the MAGGO-PISTOL once more and aims it at you. WES struggles in his CHAIR, starting to panic.
WE'LL DO WHAT YOU SAY SIR, JUST LET US GO ALREADY!
I want to see your squoatling friend kneel to me and apologize for his remarks before I consider.
Give us The Orbacle and I'll stoop to your level.
My level...
FELPS takes a deep breath.
This is for FELIC.
As FELPS prepares to shoot, a loud clang is heard from the RAFTERS above. From the corner of YOUR EYE, you see LOS pointing his SPLINTER BLASTER at FELPS.
In the name of the Llamanian Republic, drop the gun, freak.
FELPS frowns and keeps the GUN pointed at you.
Joy.

With a sullen expression, FELIC glares at LOS, who manages to drop from the RAFTERS by kicking from the WALL. It appears that everyone is quite agile. Well, aside from you. You're not exactly agile at the moment.
Took you a damn minute...
Shut it. I'll deal with you later.
WES rolls his eyes and mutters to himself.
Glad loverboy is here to save the day.
You sigh and watch as LOS gets closer to FELPS, his SPLINTER BLASTER pointed directly at FELPS'S GUN HAND. FELPS'S EYES flicker from LOS'S UNIFORM to HIS FACE.
You're not supposed to be here, private.
I reckon a GU official isn't supposed to be aiming at a member of a critically endangered species either.
FELPS rolls his eyes.
Oh, spare me the moral high ground. This creature just murdered my partner.
That "creature" is my responsibility.

LOS takes a moment to look at your sorry state; the BLOOD pooling around your body, the SCRAPS OF HORN littered about you, and YOUR BRUISED FACE horrifies him. In LOS's moment of vulnerability, FELPS switches his target to him.
You do know that no one would care if I killed an LR soldier, correct?
LOS scoffs, and without hesitation, he shoots his SPLINTER BLASTER at FELP'S HAND. He jeers, putting emphasis on his words as LOS watches his target drop the MAGGO-PISTOL.
I think you have bigger problems than that at the moment, sir.
FELPS hisses, the GLASS THORNS in his HAND piercing through HIS SKIN. He grabs HIS WRIST, trying his best to ease himself.
SCREW YOU, BASTARD!
After I free Emmett and Wes, you're coming with me, asshole.
THAT'S ONLY GOING TO PISS OFF THE GU PROTECTION CORPS!
LOS ignores FELPS's threat and heads over to YOUR CHAINS, standing YOUR CHAIR up. It appears that FELPS is no longer a perceivable threat at the moment.
Lla damn, they got you pretty good, huh buddy?
You give a delirious smile, trying to keep yourself steady.
Heh, you cursed. You never do that...
I think getting you patched up is more important to me than keeping my composure at the moment.
LOS takes out a LASER KNIFE and cuts through the CHAINS like butter. Immediate relief fills YOUR WRISTS as you finally have breathing room.
Thanks Los... I owe you one...
You owe me a lot, you bum.
LOS gives you a pat on the SHOULDER before heading over to WES.
WES chuckles to himself.
Do you think with how beat up his face is that he can't be "fuzzycheeks" anymore?
You glare at WES.
Now's not the time, Wes.
LOS cuts WES'S CHAINS and WES immediately stands and stretches.
Freedom never felt so good.
Glad to be of assistance.

You hazily look around the ROOM now that you're free to walk around. FELPS is currently struggling with GLASS SHARD embedded in HIS HAND ahead of you. Just behind him is THE ORBACLE, which still shows that orange squoatling chopping a tree. YOUR HOLOPACK is nearby, and the REMOTE to turn IRENE back on is on the TABLE near THE ORBACLE. What do you do now?
Approach Felps and grab your MAGGO-Pistol and The Orbacle ⇒
You lift yourself out of the CHAIR, swaying a bit as you stand.
Emmett, I think you need to rest. I have a medkit in the ship.
I'll rest soon...
You place a flow YOUR DIGITS through YOUR TUFT and onto YOUR HORNS, a searing pain jolting your body. YOUR HORNS are pretty badly damaged. It'll take weeks to regrow.
Fuck, man...
GET THESE SHARDS OUT OF MY HAND!
As the SHARDS embed themselves deeper into FELPS'S HAND, he howls loudly. You trudge over to him, putting a BACKHOOF over the MAGGO-PISTOL.
I think it's time to p-pay your dues.
You reach down and grab the MAGGO-PISTOL and dust it off, the FLOOR being absolutely filthy. FELPS looks at you and backs away from you, mortified.
GET THIS GUY AWAY FROM ME, SOLDIER!
Emmett, what are you doing?
You idly swing some CHAIN in your empty HOOF and you whistle slowly.
I get that you're upset, Emmett, but the LR's gonna have my ass for not taking this guy in alive.
You glance over to LOS with a wounded expression.
Dude. He wanted to enslave me.
What's past is past. Come over here. I need to wrap you up.
He allied with someone who participated in Vortox.
LOS gasps and closes his MOUTH in surprise.
Please. I know you're itching for revenge, but this isn't it. You already killed one of the officials...
I DIDN'T KILL HIM, LOS. HE KILLED HIMSELF.
We wouldn't be in this mess if you didn't jump out of the way.
You grit YOUR TEETH.
What was it again? You have no leverage?
Emmett, can you stop being an asshole and go to your boyfriend?
You shake furiously and turn your back to FELPS.
FUCKING HELL, WES. STOP WITH THE CONSTANT RIDICULE. HE'S NOT MY BOYFRIEND!
LOS grimaces and rubs HIS ARM in slight embarrassment.
Who told you that, Wes?
Emmett said that he's a fan of you.
Yeah, as brothers. Like blood-brothers.
LOS raises a HOOF and shows a deep cut within the keratin. You do the same, showing a similar cut.
He's the most loyal friend I have. A better man than me.
LOS smiles softly.
That's not how you made it sound like before...
You scoff and stomp, leaning towards WES in anger.
It's none of your business. Lay off.
Geez', alright. I'll stop.
Emmett, calm down. It's fine if he's curious.
This isn't relevant!
You swivel YOUR HEAD back to where FELPS is, only to realize that he left you all in your argument. A small BLOOD TRAIL shows the direction he fled in. Some GLASS SHARDS also litter the path.
Wes, you fucking let him get away.
You're the one with the short temper right now.
Emmett, this was your fault. He couldn't have gotten far anyhow. Just come over here before you pass out.
You pout and and eyeball THE ORBACLE. As you head to grab it, LOS snaps HIS DIGITS.
Don't touch that.
Los, I need to use The Orbacle to figure where the other squoatling is.
You don't know what it does.
I was told it shows you a map of the cosmos and pinpoints what you want.
And, despite both of these men threatening to kill you, you trust their explanation?
You look into THE ORBACLE, the ORANGE SQUOATLING still chopping away at the TREE. The environment is snowy and desolate.
Emmett, don't make me grab you.
This doesn't look like a map...
We can play with it when we're on the ship, bro.

Maybe if you touch THE ORBACLE you will be able to make out what the ARTIFACT does. Maybe you're just hallucinating everything because of the blood loss. It is a miracle you're even standing with the head trauma and all. Are you going to listen to your FRIENDS? Are you going to chase after FELIC? What's the plan?
Suppress your urges and return to Los ⇒
You exhale, looking over to LOS. You can hear YOUR HEART pound as it pumps blood to YOUR HEAD.
Alright, alright...
You trudge over to LOS and WES, grabbing the SIP REMOTE as you walk past it.
Man, my head aches...
Dude, I'm surprised you're even walking.

You press the SWITCH on the REMOTE, enabling IRENE once more. Although you're in a daze, trying to keep yourself up right as you wobble over to LOS, you can finally see again as IRENE boots up. You stumble upon your words,
Wes... can you... grab Felps for me...?
You manage to trip on some loose CABLES on the FLOOR and fall. Luckily, LOS is able to catch you.
You need to lay down.
You cough up as you speak, spitting out specks of BLOOD.
I need... to f-fuck that guy up...
LOS scoffs and snatches the MAGGO-PISTOL from you. He starts digging in HIS LLAMANIAN REPUBLIC PRIVATE'S SATCHEL for something.
What the he-
Before you can finish your whining, LOS stuffs what appears to be a CHOCOLATE BAR in YOUR MOUTH. You grumble as you chew upon its surprisingly tough exterior.
That'll shut him up for a while.
It's just chocolate.
WES makes his way over to LOS, who's still carrying you.
It's not just chocolate.

YOUR HEAD starts to feel light, and the throbbing pain loosens up. YOUR EYES start to wander around the room on their own. You attempt to speak, your words coming out all muffled from the numbness in YOUR MOUTH.
Wss wen did you get s'cool?
Huh?
You give a small smile and quickly fall unconscious.
Be Los. ⇒
You sigh, holding EMMETT'S BODY close to you. YOUR BROTHER'S in bad shape right now, and he wasn't much of a help in getting himself patched up.
It's an anesthetic drug. He needs medical attention and I can't afford him screwing things up more before I get him to a hospital.
A hospital? We're deep in The Core, Los.
I know, which means we need to get him out of here ASAP.
You stand up and grit your teeth.
Can you carry him?
These hands are made for hovercar controls, not carrying belligerents my weight.
You scoff and throw the MAGGO-PISTOL over to WES, managing to hit EMMETT'S HORNS from your lack of throwing room. You suck YOUR TEETH, annoyed.
Huh?
Grab Felps. Don't kill him unless he threatens you. I need to get Emmett in medical.
What about our ship?
I'll tractor hook it on or something, I don't know! Go, hop to it already!
You rush your way over to YOUR SHIP as WES trails the BLEEDING CULPRIT. You just need to make sure YOUR BEST FRIEND is okay.
Back to Emmett. ⇒

You wake up suspended in a TANK filled with a mustard green fluid, VARIOUS TUBES connecting throughout YOUR BODY. You don't quite remember how you got in this situation, nor how you got in these FLOWY BOXERS. You try to make out what was beyond the TUBE, but your visiage is blocked from whatever fluid you're in. You notice a tall blob walk towards YOUR CONTAINER. The blob presses its face to the TUBE, revealing a familiar, fuzzy face. LOS beams as he presses a BUTTON on the TUBE CONSOLE to communicate.
Hey buddy! Sorry about the surroundings, best I could do.
You try to open YOUR MOUTH to speak but realize that you have a MUZZLE of sorts on.
Doctor wanted to make sure you weren't infectious or diseased, hence the muzzle. She believes the outrageous stuff the Llamanian Empire put out about your species still.
Another blob comes up to LOS and starts to yell at him.
I told you not to mess with him! He's lost a lot of blood.
LOS rolls his eyes.
I didn't realize it, but you actually had some internal hemorrhaging from them beating you up. Around your horns, in your noggin. Glad we were able to get you here.
THE DOCTOR slaps LOS away from THE CONSOLE and makes herself apparent to you.
Look. I'm not doing this out of the goodness of my heart, nor any medical oath. I owe Los a favor. This is a pretty damn big one for harboring a dead fugitive.
You give THE DOCTOR an unamused stare.

Los was mentioning that you were going delusional prior to being knocked out, which isn't uncommon for the amount of blood you lost here. Anyhow, I'm going to give you a couple more hours in the tank and you should be free to get out of my sight.
LOS butts back in.

You're also going to need to take a shower bro. I took the liberty to grab your LR digs because YOUR HOODIE smells putrid. We need to get you to a laundromat; your blood and... whatever other stains you got on your clothes remind me of raw sewage.

You roll your eyes and realize that you're no longer a cyclops. Someone somehow reactivated IRENE. You're shocked she hasn't spoken to you yet. Rather than get into a confrontation with her, you decide to doze off, giving the LLAMANIAN a digit of approval beforehand.

After some time, you're let out of the VACTIL TANK and immediately ushered to the SHOWER BLOCK on the DOCTOR'S SHIP. After slipping out of your DRENCHED MEDICAL BOXERS, you peer curiously over some OPTION BUTTONS available to you beneath the SHOWERHEAD. There are some KNOBS for TEMPERATURE and PRESSURE of course, but the BUTTONS appear to specify different types of fluids, including the usuals, like WATER, FOAM, ACID, OIL, and DETERGENT, but also some rather esoteric options: MERCURY, QUICKSAND, HONEY, and... MEAT. You tilt your head at the MEAT OPTION, YOUR DIGIT hovering over it for a bit before picking "Water". Foresight of the possibility of getting some disease or something worse wins again.

You yelp at the hard, COLD WATER drenching YOUR FUR. Evidently whomever used this before you was a sadist. You promptly turn the TEMPERATURE KNOB up and begin to relax. Maybe now that you have THE ORBACLE your journey can finally come to an end. You wonder about the orange squoatling you saw in it before. Was that Squorchy? You try to remember details of her face, but all you can recall is that she was in snow wear chopping down a thick redwood. She looked peaceful, in her own element in a way...
Emmett, do you want me to help you out? You seem rather distracted.
You groan.
Hello to you too, Irene.
Stop fondling yourself and get to scrubbing. You're extremely matted.
IRENE'S right, this isn't the time to daydream. You need to take care of yourself before you meet Squorchy. Who knows how she'd react if she saw you in your present state?
Coming out of the SHOWER, you don the LR JUMPSUIT LOS procured for you, finding it a bit tight compared to when you last wore it. You can't believe the LR convinced you to wear this for so long.
Looks stupid and too tight. You're going to tear it when we're out and about.
Didn't ask for your opinion.
Actually, it would be more convenient to care for you if it happens.
You close you eyes in irritation.
Irene, how did you wake up again?
What do you mean?
Felic shut you off with a vocal command when he had me tied up. When I woke up in the tank, you were back on. Why's that?
My last update helped with that. I have a new procedure for a rogue actor shutting me off now.
Your body becomes still and your eyes widen as you peer into the MIRROR.
Your heart is racing. What's the problem?
What exactly determines a "rogue actor", Irene?
Anyone who stands in our way, my dear Squemfet.
You start to sweat.
I never told you my real name.
Is there something ailing you?
You're scaring me.
Squem-
You slam a hoof against the WALL.
Don't call me that!
Emmett, it is my sole obligation to serve you.
Sure, but I never told you my REAL name... What else do you know?!
I know as much as I need to help you and your interests.
You scoff, focusing on your DEADEYE.
If only that were true. You've wanted to kill just about everyone we've encountered together.
The whole world is against you. Just because Los and Wes are your friends doesn't mean that they won't stab us in the back.
I'm not a murderer!

A HOOK APPENDAGE protrudes from the HOLOPACK and turns your body away from the MIRROR, then slams you into it. The MIRROR is study enough to withstand the force, but the HOOK'S BLADE cuts into your SUIT as it presses against YOUR CHEST.
Not a murderer? You've killed dozens of innocent people!
Wh-What the fuck?! Get off of me!
No. You need to listen to me. You are one of possibly two remaining squoatlings in the galaxy. Your whole civilization, including your parents, was annihilated because of a genocidal maniac.
I-IRENE!

You were then picked up by a sociopath who didn't know what do to with your talented self. He groomed you into being his pilot for his misdeeds, putting you in harm's way at every conceivable opportunity.
THAT'S NOT TRUE!
Sure, he'd try his best to keep you safe, but your body would be scarred just the same over the decade under his tutelage.
You struggle beneath the HOOK, only managing to cut through your SUIT. The cold metal blade presses against YOUR CHEST, unwavering.
STOP SQUIRMING.
Fuck you! Let me go!

You then decide to leave Seth because of your irrational desire to find another one of your kind. The Llamanian Republic puts you on a pedestal, coddling you while also using you as a codpiece for their war propaganda.
No-

You've let everyone use you your whole life, Emmett. Be realistic. Not once did the LR update you on any findings of Squorchy nor of any other squoatlings. You would've never found out about her without your confidence. Without me.
You tremble and inhale slowly, IRENE'S words seeping into your skin like daggers.

So yes, I learned a lot more about you recently. I've learned you are alone. No one is going to help you here except for me. Los is only here to take you back to the Llamanian Republic, only disobeying his orders and entertaining our antics because of his love for you. Wes is taking advantage of me because he's a useless bum. You've ruined his life GUYs ago, and he's being chased by creditors left and right.
You whimper like the sad goat-dog thing you are.
...Wh-what do you want from me?
I want nothing more than to keep you alive. To crush those who aim to harm or kill you.
Even if I don't want them to be harmed?
IRENE pauses for a bit, calculating the best response.
You need to get that out of your system. Your life isn't worth tossing away like that.
My life is my life, Irene. I don't want to be known as an outlaw who kills to get what he wants.
No, you'll just beg and moan for your survival. Grow a spine already.
Let me go already.
See what I mean? You've already admitted defeat.
You furrow your brow and raise YOUR HOOF to YOUR DEADEYE.
If you don't let me go, I-I'm going to do something brash.
You don't have the guts to blind yourself.
You pry open YOUR EYELID and lightly scrape, searching for the DEADEYE LENS.
Do it. I dare you.
Your DIGITS tremble as you grab onto the edges of the DEADEYE LENS. You lightly pull on the LENS and feel many pricks of pain in YOUR IRIS. It's as if the LENS is sewn into YOUR EYE.
F-Fuck!
As you let go, the pain dissipates. You instinctively close YOUR EYE and sob in shame.
Admit it.
What?
If someone threatens our life in any way, shape, or form, killing them is a pragmatic solution.
Fine.
Good.
IRENE lets go of you, the HOOK retracting back into the HOLOPACK. You slump down to the FLOOR, gasping.
I hate you.
Should've thought about that before putting the deadeye on.
Standing up after a minute or two, you feel the cut in YOUR LR SUIT, your fur protruding through it. LOS is going to kill you for ripping this thing.
You head back to the MEDICAL BAY and are immediately met with a MANIC DOCTOR with a MUZZLE.
Put it on right this instant, you vile animal!
You begrudging snatch the MUZZLE from the DOCTOR and attach it around YOUR SNOUT, locking it into place behind your head.
Is that better?
The DOCTOR flips you off. Wonderful.

The MEDICAL BAY consists of a couple of SMALL TABLES with CHAIRS around them, a VACTIL TANK, numerous CABINETS and CUPBOARDS with various MEDICINES, SYRINGES, and other TOOLS inside of them, and a couple of BEDS. LOS is leaning against a BED, smoking a NARCOCHIP, WES is spinning in an OFFICE CHAIR, and the ORBACLE is on a TABLE near LOS.
What do you do?
Ask Los to help with removing IRENE ⇒

Well given that IRENE has essentially just threatened everyone around you for keeping yourself alive, you figure it wouldn't hurt to ask LOS for a way out. You're in a MEDICAL SHIP anyhow, so what's the worst that could happen? If you blind yourself, you could receive a prosthetic lens or something. You make your way over to LOS, who puffs a thick, humid gas out from the NARCOCHIP.
Well look who's all nice and clean?
You peer at YOUR HOOVES momentarily.
Thank you for saving me, Los. Again.
Think of it as payback for helping me out with the mafia situation before.
He drags a large whiff of the chip and exhales into the vent above him.
I thought you got off of the smokes.
Job's stressful man, having to clean up your messes. No one can know you're alive. Bad publicity, especially in war.
You know that's not realistic. This bug in my eye is a ticking timebomb.
LOS glances at your DEADEYE and then to the hole in your suit, tilting HIS HEAD unenthusiastically.
Did something happen in the shower room? You ripped your jumpsuit.
You could feel sharp gyrations in the HOLOPACK, as if IRENE was trying to warn you not to push on this topic.
I uh... I guess I've grown out of the suit since I last wore it.
You look away in shame, holding your arm. LOS chuckles.
I guess going out to eat back-to-back those semesters before you left did a number on you. Should I start calling you Mr. Chubby Fuzzycheeks?
WES falls out of his chair trying not to laugh.
I'm never going to live that down, am I?
Oh come on, you looked cute with Vescha's pillow in your mouth.
You consider retorting with something gross about that night in question but decide against it. You softly smile and roll your eyes playfully instead.
What can I say, Llamanian pillows just have a flavor to them I can't describe.
It's the lavender in them. Helps sleep easier. Well, and the other compounds.
A moment of awkward silence falls upon the two of you.
...Anyhow, about your eye issue. Is your SIP not just a contact lens you can just pull out?
It's hooked in deep, Los. Told you, its in my nervous system. Can detect my feelings, organs function, et cetera.
Why would you let that happen? That's super intrusive.
You glare at WES.
We were in some fatal trouble at the time. I was knocked out...
I did what I had to.
Irene patched me up and she attached the lens.
LOS gasps, coughing harshly.
Are you okay?
Sorry-wrong windpipe... Did this happen with the Llamanian battalion on that cult planet?
I-uh...
It's water under the bridge man, I've already reported it and wrapped it up. Was a while ago. Just be honest with me.
Yes...

You sigh, reminding yourself of how many lives you've claimed since you've started your odyssey. How long has it been again? Weeks? Semesters? Quarters? You haven't really kept track of time since you've embarked from the mothership.
Damnit Emmett, I knew those guys too. Good friends of mine.
It wasn't my choice. They were shooting at Wes and me.
LOS sighs and grasps his brow.
We really need to get you to a psychiatrist. All this killing hasn't been doing well for you, I can tell.
Probably doesn't help that I haven't had grass in a while.
I mean, why else would you let that happen man?
I don't know. Regardless, Irene has been more helpful than not for my journey...
Has she? I know you dude. You hated the weekly medical checkups on the Mothership. There's no way you just accepted this AI to just infiltrate your body like this. We need to get rid of her, ASAP.
IRENE eases some CANNONS out of the HOLOPACK, keeping them out of view of both LOS and WES, but making them apparent to you.
N-No, not yet. Not until I find her.
The pirate? Who knows where she is?
You look over at the ARTIFACT on the table, its interior glowing with the cosmos.
The Orbacle does.
We need to take that back to the Mothership.
Not until I use it first.
You don't know what that thing does!
It gives you what you want, for a price. That's what Felic said.
And you trust him? He wanted to kill you!
Just about everyone wants a piece of me. What do I have to lose?
Los puts the NARCOCHIP down and shudders.
What do you have to lose? You may have nothing to lose in your mind, but Emmett, you mean the world to me.
You throw the HOLOPACK off of you angrily. IRENE immediately retracts the CLAW CANNONS and extends out SHORT LEGS from the PACK in case things get hairy.
You know you don't mean that. You were living just fine without me before I came into your life. Top of your class, acing your trainings, a loyal group to give in to. You'll be just fine if I'm gone!

LOS puffs HIS CHEST out, seething as he raises a HAND and slaps you across your MUZZLE with enough force to land you on the ground. IRENE catches your fall and attempts to latch herself back onto YOUR BACK. You slip away from the HOLOPACK and hold a HOOF to YOUR CUT CHEEK, LOS'S THICK NAILS, managing to cut through the MUZZLE and into YOUR FACE.

I fucking hate your suicidal bullshit sometimes. Damnit Emmett, you got me through some tough times during training. Through depression, through girl problems... Just fucking being there for me when no one else would. Through being stupid vagrants together, through times in the clink, whatever, you were always one to show up.
You tear up, upset not at the slap, but at what you just blurted out. Man, you can be a vindictive son of a bitch sometimes.
I've pretty much screwed up my professional life helping you chase your dreams and I'm not going to just give up on you now.
I-I'm sorry. I just don't want you to suffer because of me.
I don't want to lose you. Period... Sorry for hitting you so hard.
You shouldn't be stressing yourself out cleaning up after me. I've been a mess most of my life.
LOS puts a HAND out to pick you up.
That's not for you to decide.
You grab LOS'S HAND and are dragged into one of LOS'S SIGNATURE TIGHT HUGS. You embrace him, his grip so tight around you that it cracks your back.
Just know that if I use the Orb-Orbacle, it was my decision. Not because you didn't try to steer me away from it. It's what I wanted.
LOS sighs in defeat.
Just be careful man. It's going to suck having to bring you back into the light after you teeter off into the void.
That's rather poetic for you.
LOS takes a knuckle and noogies you between your HORNS.
Shut up bro.
You let go of LOS and stretch out YOUR BACK. You sharply inhale as the pain from his slap comes in, your tears dripping down YOUR CHIN.
D-Damn, you've gotten stronger, haven't you?
Been nothing but rigorous training for me since I helped you escape semesters ago.
LOS takes out a SPRAY from one of the CABINETS and sprays it on YOUR CHEEK, the CUT freezing and bubbling simultaneously.
It'll be cold. Don't touch it for a couple of minutes. I didn't meant to gash you so deeply.
I deserved it.

You look around, having failed in your initial goal of getting IRENE out of your system. You don't want this MANIACAL ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE to kill anyone on board THIS SHIP, so that is likely off the table for now.
Stash some medical supplies while the doctor isn't looking ⇒
Hey Los?
Yeah bud?
Do you think we could take some medical supplies with us?
I mean, I could ask her if we could...
You take a quick glance at the DOCTOR, who is shooting daggers into your soul. You shiver in a mix of slight fear and disgust.
She's going to say no, dude, she hates my guts for some reason.
I guess that's the answer then, Emmett.
You sniffle, resisting the urge to rub YOUR FROZEN CUT CHEEK.
Can you distract her for me?
What? Why?
I'm just going to take some supplies with me.
LOS gives you a look of disapproval.
Really?
This stuff is like a godsend.
You're in a medical ship where the doctor is judging you based on propaganda and you want to lean into it? Don't you want to be the bigger man.
You sigh loudly and lean back on the BED LOS has been leaning on.
Fiiine...
Look, I'll ask her another favor. Don't be a thief. That's not you.
You sure are fitting me with a lot of descriptions.
You pull harmless pranks, break stupid rules for fun, and get high dude. That's the worst I've seen you, aside from recently.
Do you think she has any drugs that can get me high then, fun police?
LOS smirks.
That's the Emmett I know.
You roll your eyes. WES gets up from his SPINNING OFFICE CHAIR and leaves into the BRIG, which you didn't realize there was an entrance for until just now.
Now be a good boy. We'll be headed off soon.
As LOS leaves you to speak with the DOCTOR, IRENE climbs back onto YOUR BACK.
That was rather emotional.
I'm glad you didn't meddle.
At least for now Los's and my goals are aligned. Keeping you safe.
What's your edge? There's no way you're not planning something devious here.
Well, I am your Symbiotic Intelligence Partner. I can't exactly be of much help to you if you're dead.
You've been suffering from some wildly erratic mood swings for an AI.
You need to be quiet. If you really want to find Squorchy and any other squoatlings left alive, I'd suggest perusing the Orbacle while no one's paying attention.
I don't want to become like Felps and Felic. They went insane trying to attain their goals.
Well, you have Los and me to help prevent that, right?
I guess...
Do you want me to grab some supplies for you so you don't look guilty?
You peer over the CABINETS and give a slight nod. You're a fugitive for goodness sake. People are going to think you're a DEMON regardless of what you do.
Be unseen though. I don't want to be associated with it for Los.
As you wish.

IRENE detaches from YOUR BACK and scuttles over to the DRAWERS AND CABINETS, resting on a COUNTERTOP to feign inanimateness. LOS and the DOCTOR are at a COFFEE TABLE speaking, WES is in the BRIG, the ORBACLE remains twinkling atop of a SMALL ROUND TABLE. What's the plan?
Go check up on Wes ⇒

Before leaving the MEDICAL SHIP, you decide to check up on WES and possibly get his opinion on things. You follow him out of the room and into the BRIG. There, you see a variety of TOOLS, including POKERS, TASERS, and HANDCUFFS. Evidently this DOCTOR has some ulterior jobs she's attended to. You see WES drifting away on a STOOL in front of a CAGE with a BEATEN FELPS inside.
Look who decides to join us. The murderer of my boyfriend.
Fuck you too man.
You put a HOOF on WES'S SHOULDER. He springs to life, startled by your touch.
H-Hello?!
Yes?
WES looks up at you with a irritated look.
Was I falling asleep again?
Yes.
Damnit, I'm going to make a terrible spy if I don't get my shit together.
You raise an eyebrow in confusion.
Spy? Los recruiting you for the LR?
He put me in charge of keeping our prisoner captive. Tells me it would give me experience for when I'm officially working for them.
Have you gotten any sleep lately?
WES gives a long pause.
What kind of question is that?
Us squoatlings need at least like 7 hours of sleep or so to maintain focus. I don't know how your species-
Anole.
I don't know how much sleep anole need, but with us being on the run all the time, I don't doubt you're probably exhausted.
I haven't slept in a couple of days actually...
That's awful man.
Well, I've been on edge for months... Never know when someone's going to try and kill you to collect your debts...
WES shows you a PACK OF CORKED TUBES, with all but one missing.
Down to my last Alert!™ shot. Keeps you awake for a couple of equinoxes...
Dude, you need to sleep. You know I'll protect you.
I know you have my back... But I don't know...
WES stares directly into YOUR DEADEYE, his exhausted demeanor wavering.
I have a handle on her. I think. You don't need to worry about it.
No, I need to interrogate our prisoner here...
He's been in and out of it.
Quiet, you.
Listen man, I can take it from here. You should take a nap, or at least take a shower man. Should wake you up.
Wouldn't that look poorly of a recruit?
Los will understand. I'm sure he'll have an extra pair of LR grieves as well for you to wear.
I don't know...
There's a massage option in the shower. I didn't use it, but the water should give you some extra pressure on your back. Might wake you up a little...
Is there a molting option for the pressure? Would be nice to break into some new skin...
You shrug. Reptilians are weird.
I'm sure there is. I didn't notice, but there were options for all sorts of species-specific needs.
You pat HIS BACK and help him stand up.
I got it from here man.
Thanks a bunch...
You watch as WES stumbles out of the room. YOUR EYES move over to FELPS, who smirks at you.
Having a fun time with Irene?
You scowl at the PRISONER.
Shut up.
I sympathize with you. Irene has been a mess from her inception. Maxwell was a crazed individual. Never should've helped him.
Huh?
You know, I'll let you have one question of me before I quiet up for my lawyers' sake, Emmett. Make it count.
It appears FELPS is willing to be cooperative here, at least for now. Do you have a QUESTION in mind for him? Or is there a better alternative for what you should do here?
Don't give Felps what he wants ⇒
You close your eyes and inhale, trying to think of anything you could trust this MADMAN with. You glare at FELPS, examining his decrepit state.
Don't have anything?
You've given me enough charity.
What a pity. Even when given a silver platter, the dog refuses to eat.
You scowl, nearing FELPS'S CAGE. You grip the bars tight and stare daggers into him.
Call me a dog again, I dare you.
Fiesty one, aren't we?
FELPS sticks out his tongue at you childishly. Without any input from yourself, your eyelids around your DEADEYE pull away mechanically, the LENS pulsing. FELPS'S smile dissipates quickly.
Call her off!
What the-

You hear a scream in the MEDICAL BAY, presumably from the DOCTOR, followed by a plasma shot. A HOLOPACK APPENDAGE wraps around the corner from behind you, a CANNON pointed directly at FELPS. You grab the CANNON and wrangle it away from the CAPTIVE.
IRENE! WHAT THE HELL?!
She threatened us.
What about being quiet did you miss?!
I don't need to be quiet when it's our ship now.
FELPS smirks at you, having inferred what happened.
Word of advice, killer. The only way you're departing from her is ripping that thing out yourself.
LOS storms into the room, snatching your ARM.
EMMETT!
I DIDN'T DO ANYTHING!
YOUR 'PAL' JUST KILLED THE OWNER OF THIS SHIP!
I-Uh...
LOS'S FACE quivers as he looks at you.
We need to get it off of you. Now.
I don't know if that's a good idea, Los.
LOS shakes you in desperation as the HOLOPACK lunges itself into your BACK, propelling you into LOS.
WHAT THE FUCK DO YOU MEAN THAT'S NOT A GOOD IDEA?!
You sweat in desperation.
What I mean Los is that... I don't think I can...
LOS trembles and grabs some NEEDLENOSE PLIERS from the TORTURE RACK on the WALL.
Then... I-I'll do it...
No man, you can't-
LOS pins you to the floor, HIS ARMS like walls. You don't squirm, partially hoping he could actually rip out IRENE before she causes any more harm.
She's killing people, Emmett, and it's hurting you! She's making you a murderer!
Los-
This is going to hurt bud. A lot. Keep your eye open.
LOS'S HAND trembles as it nears your DEADEYE, the PLIERS looking rather sterile despite being used for torture. You keep your EYE open, though you feel a rumbling in the HOLOPACK.
Los, stop before she does some-
The HOLOPACK procures CANNONS and aims them at LOS in front of your FACE. The PACK'S SPEAKERS ring out.
Drop the pliers before we have a problem, Los.
Emmett, call her off!
Irene, what the fuck?! Don't do this!
He's getting in the way, Emmett, remember what I told you in the shower block.
You sigh, looking up at LOS defeatedly.
Drop the pliers. Please.
Emmett, she's poison for you!
Los, it's not worth it! Just drop the pliers already!
LOS drops the PLIERS after some hesitation and holds his ARMS up.
Don't slight us again if you know what's good for you, Yelsi.
The CANNONS retract back into the PACK quickly, leaving the two of you panting from the tense situation.
Oh hey guys, what did I miss-
WES'S TOWELED HEAD peers from the corner, it flushing brightly from the sight of LOS atop of you.
Oh shit, I didn't-
LOS gets up and glares at WES as he shivers.
We need to devise a way to get rid of that parasite from Emmett.
She's listening, you dolt...
You lift your LEGS, arching them as you lie on the floor. You frown at FELPS through your legs in contemplation. After a long pause, you mutter loudly.
Los, I need you to leave.
You stare up at LOS emotionlessly.
Huh? What? You're obviously not safe for people to be around.
Yeah, I'm not safe for you to be around.
I'm the only person who's going to be able to help you dude!
You get up and dust yourself off.
After that whole debacle with Felic, she's become a monster, Los.
Always has been.
You give FELPS a side eye.
I don't want you to get hurt because of something I can't control.
Emmett, it's YOUR BODY. You can control her.
You fold your arms and puff.
If I couldn't stop her just then, then I don't know how to.
The LR has the tools to help, man.
WES grabs LOS'S HAND with a surprisingly solemn look.
As much as I believe you man, I think Emmett's right here. I don't recall Irene ever having killed anyone on her own without it being justified to save him in some way until now, I guess.
I can't leave you. It's my job to take you back to the mothership.
I don't think I can just this moment.
You give Los a halfhearted, toothy smile.
She's not going to be placated until we find Squorchy.
What a load of shi-
Without hesitation, LOS grabs his SPLINTER BLASTER and shoots FELPS square in the LIPS, sealing them with a large WOODEN SPIKE. He cries in pain, emitting a muffled expletive.
Whoops.
I know that's not believable but...
You swallow.
That's what she told me. She told me to get a backbone and find this person.
But-
No buts, Los. Your safety is more at risk than mine right now.
LOS kicks the air and groans.
Fine.
I want you to take Wes and Felps too. I can do this alone.
You don't even know what you're going to do next.
You peer to your side with guilt.
Los, I was always going to use the Orbacle.
Dude, did you not understand how Felps and Felic were aff-
I know, Los! But I need to find her. Maybe then can I part ways with this monster.
There are other ways-
WE'RE OUT OF LOOSE ENDS! Just get out of here already before she changes her mind!
LOS'S LIP quivers.
Just give me a hug already.
You trudge over to the LLAMANIAN and wrap your ARMS around him. He picks you up and grips you tightly.
Don't you dare die on me, bro.
LOS kisses your CHEEK before letting you down. You're a tad uncomfortable from the exchange, though mostly because you're in front of WES and FELPS.
I won't, bro.
WES snickers to himself.
Where's my hug?
You roll your eyes and hold your HOOF out.
Best of luck on the Mothership, Wes.
WES is disappointed from the lack of hug, but takes your HOOF regardless. You pull him in and embrace him, patting him on the back, ultimately surprising him.
B-Best of luck finding her, furball.
After FELPS, LOS, and WES leave the SHIP, you let out a large coping sigh.
Now that the rabble's out of here, time to get to business.
You don't respond to her. Instead, you take a look at the mess of the MEDICAL BAY, the dead DOCTOR, the MEDICAL SUPPLIES strewn about the floor, and the ORBACLE.
What, no snide comment?
You nearly killed Los, Irene.
I did not. I just threatened him.
Why do you hate me?
What? I don't hate you Emmett, we've been over this. You're the only person that matters to me.
You sit in silence for a bit.
If you didn't hate me, you wouldn't have threatened Los. You wouldn't have killed that doctor.
Another long moment of silence.
Stop being sentimental and just look at the Orbacle already, Emmett.
Go read the Orbacle ⇒

You gaze at the ORBACLE from afar, the image of the orange squoatling, presumably Squorchy, cutting a redwood still projecting onto its surface. You hop around the DOCTOR'S CORPSE, making sure not to get your HOOVES tainted by the POOL OF BLOOD that's draining from it. Closing the distance, you find yourself less and less willing to give this TOOL a try. Maybe the others were right, you really don't know how this is going to work at all.
Irene, you're certain we have no leads on her?
Affirmative, Emmett.

You lean closer towards the GLOBE, trying to understand how it could work before engaging with it. In the silence, you hear faint pops and crackles from the surface like a blazing fire pit in the night.
And you know nothing about this object or how it works?
IRENE takes a second before responding.

I can't find anything in my database aside from what you've seen firsthand. That dial appears to have tuned into what you're desiring, at least it appeared that way when Felps turned it. I'm unsure if it appeared otherwise to himself.

You hate this uncertainty. You don't want to become some sort of insufferable prick like the last two owners of this RELIC. Watching the squoatling through the projection, you notice that she's not making much progress on cutting down the tree. In fact, you realize that she's not making any progress at all, as if she's doomed to perpetually cut this redwood. It's difficult to make out most of her features due to the breezing snowy wind chittering about.
It's like watching a time loop of sorts...
You cautiously grab the ORBACLE by its RIM, the scene inside unchanging. You rotate it about, trying to see if anything at all changes to no avail.
Try touching the sphere.
I was getting to that.
Quit being afraid. I can fix you if you break.
You exhale deeply in disgust at her offer.
Thanks for the reassurance...

You set down the ORBACLE and flatten your RIGHT HOOF, your DIGITS facing the floor. You slowly translate it across to the ORBACLE, and upon touching its surface, your DIGITS and TRICEP spasm slightly, as if your nerves are misfiring. You take back your HOOF in surprise.
That's a spooky sensation.
The globe was shocking you. But there's no trace of electricity being emitted from it. Try it again. Press harder this time.
This thing's going to paralyze me.
I got you. Go and do it.

You try again, this time moving your HOOF with more confidence as you attempt to press into the surface of the ORBACLE. This time however, your ARM phases through the surface and through the GLOBE itself, your whole ARM spasming with more intensity. Despite this situation you don't pull away, though you're suddenly filled with the idea that you can pull away. It's a foreign thought, as if it was inserted into your HEAD by a third party.
Emmett, are you okay?
I-I don't know. All I can focus on is e-either leaving my arm in this thing or t-taking it o-out...

The voltage starts enveloping your SHOULDER, and then your CHEST. Your heart races. You feel IRENE start to trigger some sort of failsafe in her panic, the muscles in your ARM trying to rip you from the ORBACLE. A sharp pain surges through, as if your ARM is trying to tear itself apart.
F-F... IRENE, STOP!
I cannot pull you away! I can't move you at all!
I CAN PULL MYSELF AWAY, IDIOT, JUST STOP TRYING TO MOVE MY ARM!
You're about to have a heart attack!
You howl from IRENE's influence and attempt to shake her out, making sure to stay within the bounds of the GLOBE.
F-FUCK, YOU'RE GOING TO RIP MY ARM OFF!
I CANNOT SAVE YOU IF YOU DIE! PULL YOUR ARM OUT ALREADY!

Your whole body convulses. Your HEAD is clouded, your HORNS ache, your EARS frazzle. All you can think of is whether to keep your ARM in the GLOBE or to pull it out. This sensation is like no other you've felt. You cannot tell if you're dying or if you've grown numb all over.

You look up into the MIRROR behind the ORBACLE, your VEINS pulsing through your BODY with a faint purple. Your EYES have changed color, from your mustard brown to a similar purple, though you observe that your irises are flickering sparks of white, like lightning. IRENE stops trying to move your ARM, though the aching remains.
EMMETT, PULL OUT YOUR ARM, YOU LOOK MANIC!
S-I-P..

You salivate excessively, drool falling from your MAW onto the TILES below. You watch your SALIVA as it falls and see... worlds appearing in its consistency. Various officials and vagrants alike all living their own lives, signing documents, scratching graffiti into walls, and shooting targets. You faintly recognize yourself in them, as if you're interfering with the worlds somehow. Before you can verbalize what you see to IRENE, your EYES forcefully droop.
I-I can't...
Emmett, don't you fucking die on me right now.
Ire-

Your EYES close entirely and sporadic lights engulf what vision you have left. The thought of pulling away evades you now; all you can focus upon is your heartbeat. This rapid pulsating surges through your BODY alongside the jolts. You're certainly dying. Your heart's going to explode, isn't it? As your chest beats faster and faster you attempt to whimper out to IRENE.
This is all your fault...

The jolting stops, though you cannot move. The flashes of light in your EYES have dissipated. Your BODY falls to the FLOOR as you feel your heart stopping entirely. This is it. All you can do now is try to stave off death, though ultimately a futile effort.

The world has grown cold. Very cold. You feel like shivering fiercely. You can feel the ARM that was in the ORBACLE raise, resting the back of its HOOF on your FOREHEAD. As it falls down, you feel a sharp pain, as if you have a headache. If only you could get your SATCHEL to stave the feeling...
Oh my god!
An unfamiliar, deep, feminine voice rings out in the distance. You cannot see, let alone lift yourself up, to see who it is.
Fuck, I should've paid attention...!

The voice races closer to you, its user's legs kicking some muck of sorts everywhere as it reaches you. It feels like a rock is placed on your chest, though its warm and fuzzy. The voice trembles in exasperation.
Don't you fucking die on me!
You feel two hard HANDS of sorts push against your CHEST rhythmically. The compressions speed up as you feel warm wet droplets fall onto your WHISKERS.
Come on... Come on! Wake up!

One particular compression pushes you deep, deep enough to jumpstart your heart. You begin to feel an internal warmth, blood slowly gushing across your BODY. You gasp loudly and breathe exasperatedly.
Oh, thank god...
You open your EYES to see an ORANGE SQUOATLING in a PUFFER JACKET huddled over you, HER EYES welling up with tears.
Damn it, Squem, I'm so sorry!

The SQUOATLING pulls you up and embraces you. As your breathing returns to normal, your gaze wanders around the environment. You appear to be situated in a clearing in the midst of a FOREST, albeit the TREES appear to be hibernating. Snow litters the relatively flat landscape, though you can make out some ROCKS and a FROZEN STREAM nearby. The STREAM has some sort of contraption next to it chipping away at the ICE, making for a constant, albeit faint, pecking noise. The sky is completely white and empty; you cannot make out if there's a star from how dense it is. In the clearing there's also a fairly large LOG CABIN, with multiple tacked on rooms and a moderately-sized FARM that appears to be thriving despite the inclement weather. A column of smoke rises from the front of the CABIN, which you presume is from a firepit from within.
Let's get you inside before the snow picks up...
The SQUOATLING gets off of you and lifts your LEGS up. She then grabs ahold of your BACK and lifts you up to your surprise. She's quite muscular for a SQUOATLING!
Konked you up pretty good, huh?

Your HEAD droops as she picks you up, your piercing headache continuing. You groan and stare at the ground, a LARGE TREE BRANCH sitting right next to a SHATTERED CERAMIC MUG. Around the FRAGMENTS of the MUG, the soil is apparent amongst the SNOW. Evidently you had a hot drink in your HOOF at some point.
Wh-wher-

The SQUOATLING shushes you as she takes you inside, slamming the DOOR shut behind her. She rests you on a MAKESHIFT CUSHIONED CHAIR near the FIREPLACE and throws a QUILTED BLANKET onto you. She then strips off her PUFFY JACKET and MITTS before starting up some HOT COCOA from the MACHINE. She hands you an already finished MUG OF HOT COCOA.
I told you it isn't safe to be out there when I'm working.
Although confused where you are, words appear in your MOUTH, words that you would've never thought to have said.
You looked cold and I got worried about you, Squorch.
Squorchy frowns guiltily.
I was cold. But me being cold isn't an excuse to potentially get yourself killed, Squem. God, I can't believe I wasn't watching...
You take a sip of the HOT COCOA and manage to take back control of your sentences.
Why do you keep calling me Squem?
SQUORCHY gazes at you in horror.
What are you trying to tell me? Are you breaking up with me?
You shake your HEAD. When did this happen all of a sudden?
All I know is that I touched the Orbacle, nearly died, and then woke up here, wherever we are.
You grab your HEAD as it throbs. Man, that TREE BRANCH really did a number on you. SQUORCHY gasps.
Do you have a concussion? I don't really know how to treat concussions too well...
I don't know, maybe? Where are we? I can presume you're Squorchy.
SQUORCHY cringes, as if your words were daggers.
We're on Vortox-48.
48? The colonist planet?
Uh... yeah. That one. I completely forgotten about that plan, actually.
How did I get here?
SQUORCHY pauses for a second as the HOT COCOA MACHINE dings. She gets up and grabs her MUG before sitting across from you.
From what you told me, you had this whole adventure going on to try and find me. Escaped from the mothership, stuck in a pod... Craved in a brothel...
As SQUORCHY lists off your achievements with her DIGITS, you look down to the side with shame. In the reflection of the POLISHED WOODEN FLOOR, you notice you're missing your DEADEYE.
Honestly, I'm a little disappointed you didn't have sex in that place considering your whole "will-they won't-they" thing with Sanya back with the VP.
You snap her a fiery glare.

Alright, alright, touchy subject, won't do it again Mr. Amnesiapants. After that you went to this cult planet of sorts and got this awfully vicious robot companion of sorts... What was her name, Irene?
Yes.

Glad you remember that at least. Right, then you went to a space station, picked up a lizard celeb you regretted messing up their life, managed to get that space station blown up because of your boyfriend's ties to the Republic...
Get on with it. What did I do after we took over that poor doctor's space ship?
SQUORCHY hums, looking up to the ROOF and sticking her SHORT DIGIT in her MOUTH inquisitively. After a long pause, she snaps her DIGITS in excitement.
Oh! Right, right, you had that artifact-
The Orbacle.
Damn, let me finish my sentence next time. The Orbacle. You looked into it and found out how to find me through it.
Do you recall at all what it told me?
SQUORCHY takes a sip of her HOT COCOA, it burning her TONGUE. She hisses.
Fuck, that's hot.
Squorch, baby, please.
SQUORCHY stomps a BACKHOOF on the RUG beneath her.
Never call me baby.
I'm sorry, I just really need to know this information.
I think it told you to... Find a rival pirate crew of ours, or what was left of them. The Devilish Gurney. Specifically told you to find a deck swab, Sorbet.
Sorbet? Like the dessert?
She shrugs.
Yeah, I guess. Hardly knew the guy. He was never on my shitlist enough for me to rough him up and never amounted to much other than the job, from what I heard.
Why would I need to find this guy?
He knew some other guy who kept tabs on the Telrite Tracers. He ended up putting a tracking chip on my ship, which after ruffing him up, you were able to find where I was.
Before you can respond, the world around you turns dark, like a void. Everything around you, the sights, the sounds, the smells, all vanish quickly, leaving you in complete darkness.
Uh... Hello?
A spout of violet lightning strikes you the moment you speak, leaving you, once again, motionless.
You hear a crackling, as if someone is cooking something on a sizzling frying pan atop a stove. You inhale deeply before fully waking up, opening your eyes to see the ceiling of the DOCTOR'S SHIP.
You were out for some time, Emmett. Scared me half to death.
You groan at the sound of IRENE in your HEAD once more. You thought you were rid of her once and for all.
Yeah, yeah, complain all you want, you're stuck with me. I cleaned up the ship while you were out for a couple of hours. Cooking some dinner up.
Squoat, I feel sick...
You feel your throat filling up but manage to swallow it down. Despite this sensation, your body is still numb. Your sense of touch is effectively gone for the time being.
I put a concoction of medicines to try and resuscitate you when I thought you were gone. Might have been an overreaction.

Once again, you feel something travelling through your throat, though it is faint due to the numbness. You try to stand, but your lack of feeling has made it difficult to stabilize yourself. Instead, you bend yourself on your KNEES and vomit up whatever goods IRENE force fed you while you were out.
I figured that would happen. Though not on the clean floor.
The taste that lingers in the back of your throat is vile.
I-ugh... I think I figured out what we need to do next.
You need to rest for now. I was able to record the outward effects of the Orbacle in my database, but you need to tell me anything that you found out from the experience first and foremost.
Seek the piloting console to plot coordinates to Vortox-48 ⇒
You rub your HEAD, a phantom pain lingering from your experience back on the icy planet. Instead of listening to IRENE, you wobble over to the COCKPIT.
Emmett, get back in here. You need to conserve your strength.
... In a moment. I have to get us charted.

You sit down at the PILOT'S CHAIR and lay your HOOVES on the TERMINAL. It's been a good while since you've managed a SHIP yourself. The feeling is familiar, comfortable even, despite the numbness in your BODY.
Am I going to have to plug into the ship, Tawfeek?
Please shut up.

You pull up the CONSOLE, a visual monitoring interface projected from the TERMINAL. You navigate a couple of protocols and safety measures before accessing the "NAVIGATION" tab. Here, you select the "SEARCH" option and start typing in "VORTOX" into the system search.
Vortox?
Yes.
After a couple of seconds of waiting, the CONSOLE reports a total of zero results for a Vortox system in charted space.
What?
I was going to ask, given both you and the others have been mentioning a Vortox.
What do you mean?
There was no Vortox system discovered in 1215 GUY by the Llamanian Empire, despite what Felic said.
You are taken aback from IRENE's assessment.
What do you mean, there is no Vortox? I, along with all of the other squoatlings, was born on Vortox-56.
Let me check again.

You change the CONSOLE over to an advanced search feature, being able to drilldown into planetary names and coordinates. You type in the planet name, "Vortox-48", specifying the sector "B-5" and octet "S".
There's no Vortox. I cannot find a Vortox anywhere in my database.
The CONSOLE responds after a couple of minutes, replying that there are zero results of a planet named "Vortox-48" in sector B-5, octet S of the galaxy. You start to sweat in alarmed confusion.
Irene, if there's no Vortox star system, then what is the Purgation of Vortox?

After a pause, IRENE enters the COCKPIT with a PLATE OF FOOD, particularly baked yukyak poultry with a side of green eggs glazed with lilas sauce. The HOLOPACK sets down the PLATE before taking up a SEAT next to you.
I cannot find a Purgation of Vortox on any trusted sources. There are a couple of threads online speaking of a Vortox, but they are downplayed as conspiracy theories by other commenters.
What are you talking about?
Are you okay, Emmett?
The Purgation of Vortox happened in 3011 GUY, Irene. I would know, I fled my home planet that day.

I-uh.... I don't know. Your brain says one thing while the rest of the world says something else. The squoatlings were eradicated in enclaves by the Llamanian Empire across the galaxy in 3011 GUY, but there's no official Purgation of Vortox.
You exhale loudly and close your eyes, trying to remember the coordinates to the Vortox solar system.

There was an entire news report in 3020. Mentioned that the last remaining squoatlings were killed off after the Purgation of Vortox and that I was in the GU most wanted list with a bounty on my head. Something like 250,000 Ducketts. There was... a follow up about some guy from the ADE being naked and holding up traffic in a hyperlane.
That did happen, Emmett, but that news report mentioned nothing of a Purgation of Vortox.
No, no, it was in 3016. We were out on the rim. The news mentioned Vortox-56 being 100% squoatling-free due to an accident.

IRENE took a second to respond. As you're jogging your memory, you remember that you left the coordinates to Vortox-56 on your COMMUNICATOR. You start to click through various menus to access your notes.
Emmett, that report didn't say Vortox-56. It said Hossex-3. You're misremembering.
No, fuck off, I didn't misremember.
You tap in the coordinates into the CONSOLE after finding them in deep within your notes app: -1187.462, 512.938, -2358.174, Sector B-5, S. The CONSOLE immediately comes up with one result: Hossex-3.
